channel.name: Theo Browne
channel.description: Theo is a software dev, AI nerd, TypeScript sympathizer, creator of T3 Chat and the T3 Stack.

title: I think I'm addicted to Opus 4.5...
description:
I wanted to make a comparison video between Gemini, Claude, and GPT, but honestly Opus 4.5 is so good I don't even think I can...

Thank you Convex for sponsoring! Check them out at: https://soydev.link/convex

Want to sponsor a video? Learn more here: https://soydev.link/sponsor-me

Check out my Twitch, Twitter, Discord more at https://t3.gg

S/O Ph4se0n3 for the awesome edit 🙏
